what_it_does: AMD's Pensando Pollara 400 is a programmable SmartNIC — a specialized network card that can run custom software to process incoming network packets at high speed. In enterprise AI data centers, ordinary network cards just shuffle data, but Pollara 400 can make intelligent decisions: routing traffic, balancing load across servers, enforcing security policies, or running machine-learning tasks directly in the network hardware. It targets 400 gigabits per second throughput and integrates multiple compute cores, fast memory hierarchies, and switching fabric designed specifically for flexible, in-network computation.
